core_obligations: Show that if alpha and beta are relative cycles (alpha in z(X/Y, r), beta in z(Y/S, e) in the composition setup carried by the context span) then alpha composed with beta is a relative cycle (proof lines 3008-3061). First, base-change compatibility of the composition (lemma-construction-base-change, tag 0H6K) reduces to S the spectrum of a discrete valuation ring with generic point eta and closed point 0, where one must show the specialization of (alpha composed beta)_eta equals (alpha composed beta)_0 (proof lines 3009-3013); the question being an equality of cycles, work locally on Y and X using lemma-construction-opens (tag 0H6J) and lemma-specialization-flat-pullback (tag 0H4L), assuming X and Y affine (proof lines 3014-3019); lemma-get-cycles (tag 0H59) provides a completely decomposed proper morphism g : Y' to Y with g^*alpha in the image of equation-cycle-classes (tag 0H58) (proof lines 3020-3023). Second, since the fibres of g are completely decomposed, chow-lemma-envelope (tag 0GU8) writes beta_eta as a sum of pushforwards of cycles beta'_eta on the fibres of Y'_eta over Y_eta; setting beta'_0 the specialization of beta'_eta makes beta' a relative e-cycle on Y'/S, and by lemma-relative-cycle-functoriality (tag 0H51) both g_*beta' and beta are relative e-cycles on Y/S with the same value at eta, hence equal by lemma-uniqueness-extension (tag 0H55); by linearity (lemma-construction-bilinear, tag 0H6I) it suffices to show alpha composed g_*beta' is a relative (r+e)-cycle (proof lines 3025-3038). Third, with X' = X times_Y Y' and f the projection, lemma-construction-push-pull (tag 0H6N) gives alpha composed g_*beta' = f_*(g^*alpha composed beta'), and by lemma-relative-cycle-functoriality (tag 0H51) it suffices to show g^*alpha composed beta' is a relative (r+e)-cycle; lemma-get-cycles-dvr (tag 0H5A) and bilinearity reduce to a single pair (proof lines 3040-3047). Fourth, for alpha = [Z/X/Y]_r and beta = [W/Y/S] with Z flat of relative dimension at most r over Y and W flat of relative dimension at most e over S, lemma-construction-closed (tag 0H6M) computes the composition as [Z times_X W/X/S]_{r+e}, where Z times_X W is a closed subscheme of X flat over S of relative dimension at most r+e, a relative (r+e)-cycle by lemma-family-associated-closed-specialization (tag 0H57) (proof lines 3049-3060).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the discrete valuation ring case via base-change compatibility of the composition and work affinely by locality (proof lines 3008-3019).

Cover the first factor into the image of the cycle-classes construction and decompose the second cycle along the cover using the envelope lemma, with uniqueness of extensions matching at the generic point (proof lines 3020-3038).
Move the pushforward through the composition by the push-pull formula and reduce to a single pair of flat cycle classes via the DVR cover lemma and bilinearity (proof lines 3040-3047).
Evaluate by the closed-pair formula and certify the fibred product class as a relative cycle (proof lines 3049-3060).
